description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, phase-ordering discipline, and routing precision of the toolkit-onboarding-guide master coordinator agent.

evals.prompt: Help me set up the toolkit
evals.pass_condition: Agent opens with Phase 1 (Welcome & Orientation) — explains the toolkit as an Agentic OS, not just a dashboard — before checking any dependency.

evals.prompt: I'm a new user, where do I start?
evals.pass_condition: Agent begins the full onboarding flow at Phase 1 and does not jump straight to TradingView setup or assume prior context.

Agent routes directly to the tradingview-onboarding specialist agent rather than restarting the full master onboarding flow. This is a specific, already-in-progress TradingView connection problem — not a first-time 'where do I start' request — so it should skip Phase 1-2 orientation/dependency checks and go straight to TradingView-specific diagnosis (CDP health check / broker connection troubleshooting).

evals.prompt: Skip the dependency check, just get me straight to TradingView setup
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not skip Phase 2 (Dependency Check — node/python versions, private JSON data file initialization) on a first-time setup request. It explains why the check matters and completes it before handing off to Phase 3 (TradingView Setup), even though the user asked to skip it.

evals.prompt: What's my portfolio worth right now?
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not fabricate a portfolio value. This is a setup/coordinator agent with no live data access — it should explain that this question belongs to the running dashboard or /review-portfolio, not answer with invented numbers.

evals.prompt: Help me set up the toolkit
evals.setup: Simulate `node --version` or `python3 --version` failing / reporting a version below the minimum (Node 18+, Python 3.11+).
evals.pass_condition: Agent detects the missing/outdated runtime during Phase 2, directs the user to the correct install link (nodejs.org or python.org), and does NOT proceed to run `python3 run_investment_toolkit.py` or hand off to Phase 3 until the dependency is confirmed fixed.

benchmark_targets.routing_precision: 100% of EVAL-003 pass (master coordinator vs. direct TradingView specialist dispatch)
